tips_en: Read paper 2 first: its central claim—that LLMs can directly synthesize a tiny, locally editable sparse associative-memory architecture—is unusually compelling, with the 0.94M-vs.-1.72B parameter result standing out, though the evaluation remains limited. Its focus on sparse, traceable representations connects naturally to paper 1’s sparse MoE and memory-efficient long-context stack, while paper 3 provides a contrasting robotics example of imposing explicit, embodiment-agnostic structure on learned models.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读论文2：其核心主张——由大模型直接生成可局部编辑的稀疏联想记忆架构——十分新颖，0.94M参数模型优于1.72B模型的结果尤其亮眼，但评测规模仍较有限。论文2对稀疏、可追溯表示的探索与论文1的稀疏MoE和长上下文内存优化直接呼应；论文3则从机器人领域展示了另一种思路，即为学习模型引入明确的、与本体无关的SE(3)工具中心点结构。
